forward: External ask delegates to mova_teacher; supplied projection maps named usage fields; optional journal preserves order.
inverse: Default fibers admit absent/mistyped zero fields; journal fibers admit blank lines, whitespace and legacy default omission.
limitations: No live process/teacher tests; no concurrency/crash durability guarantee; finite synthetic evidence only.
